title: Labyrinth
build: Two-sided English disk edition; stored credit at $743D-$747D includes V 1.0 V; supplied G64 preservation images

accuracy.note: Bronze: opening snapshot, nine comments, initial hardware and string sweeps. No independent sample or audit.
Expanded Bronze trace: graphical play reached; room resources captured; dialogue dictionary decoded, with script-generated record comments. No independent sample or audit.

Word-wheel input, prefix matching, command dispatch, and drawing: ten additional routine descriptions. G/Z/O and Delete checked in VICE; committed tests run the original routines. No independent comment sample.

Opening movement/reply dispatch and mixed GO HOME table: nine descriptions. Page behavior compared with all 14 original handler decisions; reply strings compared with the original text parser. No independent comment sample.

Ticket inventory entry, eastward gate, outside handler, and mixed east table: six descriptions. Recovered command-handler code through known dispatch entries. Eastward selection checked for 3,584 location/ticket-byte cases; complete purchase tested with one through nine owned dollars. No independent listing sample.

Popcorn dollar-payment branch: one description, checked with one through nine owned dollars and every purchase flag (2,304 cases). Three reply streams checked with the original parser. No independent listing sample.

54 opening text records ($9816-$A3D6): generated descriptions from decoded streams, all 54 compared with the original parser. Tests also check record bounds, listing-comment text and the setup-written dictionary operand. Three continuation/operand descriptions bound the editable reply. No independent sample or audit.

Opening-only ledger: 48,261/48,261 described bytes, including provenance-only descriptions of 2,365 opaque retained bytes with purpose unknown. Fresh hand-over matches all TX payload bytes; startup/play changes assigned. Recovered API, IRQ and computed-dispatch targets; all 127 opening streams, 58 headered messages and 255 sound events checked against original routines. Exhaustive random/scale cases, painter, clearing, screen shifts, pointer boundaries, colour and IRQ cases checked. No independent sample or audit; 21 graphical parts remain unanalysed.

Popcorn change: correct the mistaken no-direct-reference comments at $968C/$968D, trace TAKE/complaint/nickel-return consumers, and add a checked interactive example. Two ordinary-input VICE sequences; 7,995 original-code counter transitions, twelve live scalar transitions, and nine isolated later popcorn offers. No independent comment sample or audit.

Partial natural gate image: 771/43,949 bytes described. Original-code classifier, threshold, delay and deferred dispatch tests plus ordinary joystick trials and a live scene-request watch. Shared resident ownership unresolved; provisional independent image scopes. No independent comment sample or audit.

Gate/shared introduction sequence: seven original-parser speech checks and 15,360 isolated dispatcher cases, including name insertion and scene-dependent skip. Gate ledger 2,059/43,949 bytes; ordinary speech presentation, input meanings and pose identities remain open. No independent comment sample or audit.
